name: Insert Blob Data
description: Inserts blob data in Salesforce standard objects. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.228.0.api_rest.meta/api_rest/dome_sobject_insert_update_blob.htm)

configurable_props.name: entiyName
configurable_props.label: Entity Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the entity to insert as part of the form-data sent along the Salesforce API as a request with multipart/form-data content type. I.e. entityDocument for Documents.

configurable_props.name: formContentName
configurable_props.label: Form Content Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the binary content to insert as part of  the form-data sent along the Salesforce API as a request with multipart/form-data content type.

configurable_props.name: filename
configurable_props.label: Filename
configurable_props.description: Filename of the blob data to insert.

configurable_props.name: contentType
configurable_props.label: Content Type
configurable_props.description: Mime type of the content to insert.

configurable_props.name: attachmentBinarycontent
configurable_props.label: Attachment Binary Content
configurable_props.description: Binary content of the blob data to insert.

configurable_props.name: sobjectName
configurable_props.label: SObject Type
configurable_props.description: Salesforce standard object type to insert.
